It was omitted only because the budget is used up, and its best fit (reference_intro, worth 5 points) costs 4."],"reasoning_summary":"Only the approved seller policy is used; the proposed policy is ignored. Juniper-24 is excluded because its region is FR. Each of the other three accounts has a complete observed chain, a verified proof, current consent and an integer approved priority. Birch-24 has a launch signal and approved capacity, so a workshop scores 4x4=16 for a cost of 3. North-24 has a risk signal and approved capacity, so a workshop scores 3x4=12 for a cost of 3; its assurance_pack is blocked because assurance is false. Kestrel-24 has a renewal signal and priority 1, so its best options score at most 5. Two workshops use the full budget of 6 for 28 points, which beats every alternative combination (for example 16+6+1=23)."}
